# Sanjeev Kumar

Sanjeev Kumar is a Level 3 personal trainer in Vancouver and South Surrey, British Columbia, Canada.

He offers in-person training packages, online consultations, and free guidance on longevity, mobility and endurance.

Credentials: NASM, ISSA, ProNatal and Hypervolt.

- Home: https://www.getfitwithsanjeev.com/
- About: https://www.getfitwithsanjeev.com/about.html
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/sanjeev-kumar-0387b6207

Package sizes, session lengths and prices are not published. Consultations currently start from the contact form. A booking page is planned.
